entries.title: A clear path with MentorMe
entries.short_answer: MentorMe gives you a structured path instead of leaving you to jump between random courses. You choose a direction, learn useful skills, practise them and build work you can show.
entries.detailed_answer: MentorMe connects the whole journey: career direction, focused lessons, practical missions, projects and visible proof. Each stage helps you see what to do next and how your work is moving you forward.

Build skills through focused learning and practical work.

entries.title: Learn, practice, build, prove
questions: What happens after I sign up
entries.short_answer: Choose a direction, then learn, practise, build and prove your skills one step at a time. The goal is to finish useful work and know what comes next.
entries.detailed_answer: You begin by choosing a direction and forming a learning plan. Focused lessons lead into missions and challenges, then projects and assessments help turn your learning into portfolio proof.

entries.title: A useful next step

entries.short_answer: MentorMe is for students and learners who want a clearer career direction and a practical way to make progress. You can start with foundations and build toward work you can show.
entries.detailed_answer: If you feel unsure where to begin, the journey starts with direction and strengths. If you already have an interest, you can explore its track and use levels, practice and projects to build evidence of your skills.
bullet_points: A connected learning sequence.
Practice and projects that demonstrate skills.
Visible milestones and portfolio evidence.

entries.title: Beyond watching courses
entries.short_answer: MentorMe connects learning with practice and projects, so your next step is an outcome to complete. Progress is about what you can build and explain.
entries.detailed_answer: The learning system pairs focused concepts with deliberate practice, project work and assessments. Your portfolio grows with your progress, giving you visible evidence beyond course completion.

entries.detailed_answer: You build a portfolio story and prepare your résumé, LinkedIn profile and professional introduction as you move toward career readiness. Course completion brings a Course Completion Certificate and eligibility for startup internship opportunities, subject to the opportunity's requirements.
